families.title: The laboratory record
families.blurb: The two tables everything else hangs off: one row per synthesis attempted, one row per instrument file measured.

tables.name: synthesis_experiments
tables.comment: Parent table of the project: one row per synthesis attempted, keyed on sample_code. Gathers the theoretical design, the solvents, the thermal ramp and the modulators from five years of laboratory notebooks. Written by UPSERT from notebook 01, never by DELETE, so it cannot erase rows created by the n8n workflow.

tables.name: characterization_measurements
tables.comment: Child table storing raw characterization data and header metadata in standardized JSONB format

tables.name: characterization_measurements_test
tables.comment: Test copy of characterization_measurements, used to exercise the ingestion pipeline without touching real data. Not part of the production flow.

families.title: Chemistry reference
families.blurb: Turns a chemical symbol into physics. Populated from mendeleev, pymatgen and RDKit, and every value traceable to a citation.

tables.name: element_properties
tables.comment: One row per element used as a metal_center in synthesis_experiments. Properties that belong to the element itself (electronegativity, hardness) rather than to a specific ion (see ion_properties). Populated by src/build_element_properties.py.

tables.name: ion_properties
tables.comment: Radius and charge density per (element, oxidation state, coordination number). Coordination number is pinned to 6 everywhere in this project (see roadmap SS3.4: the true CN is unknown before synthesis, and Shannon CN=6 radii are both the most tabulated and the ones that preserve relative ordering between metals).

tables.name: linker_properties
tables.comment: One row per linker code used in synthesis_experiments.linker. scaffold + protection_state are the two independent axes hidden inside the 6 linker names (roadmap SS1.3/SS4.2): H6ttbmp/Et6ttbmp are the same molecule as acid/ester, same for H8ptp/Et8ptp. Populated by src/build_linker_properties.py from hand-verified SMILES -- see methodology/PENDIENTE_ML_INPUTS_HUMANOS.md for the one identification (H6ttbmp) that needs Ruben's confirmation.

tables.name: metal_source_oxidation_state
tables.comment: Maps every distinct synthesis_experiments.metal_source string to the metal and oxidation state implied by its chemical formula. Deterministic where the formula is unambiguous (roadmap SS3.3, option 1); a handful of rows are flagged matches_metal_center=FALSE where metal_source disagrees with metal_center -- these are real data-entry questions, listed in methodology/PENDIENTE_ML_INPUTS_HUMANOS.md, not modelling choices.

tables.name: property_sources
tables.comment: Citation + DOI for every property in element_properties/ion_properties/linker_properties. Exists because e.g. "electronegativity" alone is ambiguous (Pauling vs Allen give different orderings for transition metals) -- see roadmap SS3.1.

families.title: Signal and ground truth
families.blurb: What the diffractograms became: 29 deterministic descriptors per curve, and the human verdicts that no pipeline can recompute.

tables.name: pxrd_descriptors
tables.comment: Canonical crystallographic descriptor vector derived deterministically from each PXRD diffractogram. One row per measurement. Specified in methodology/ROADMAP_PXRD_CRISTALINIDAD_Y_ML.md, Etapa 3.

tables.name: pxrd_labels
tables.comment: Human ground-truth labels for PXRD diffractograms. Keyed on file_hash rather than measurement_id so that labels survive a re-ingestion of characterization_measurements. The most expensive data in the project: it cannot be recomputed.

families.title: The model registry
families.blurb: Five tables holding the full lineage of every model trained: the recipe, the dataset snapshot, the features kept and excluded, the metrics, and the binary.

tables.name: ml_models
tables.comment: One record per trained model. Holds the complete RECIPE (data, code, parameters, seed, versions); the binary lives apart in ml_model_artifacts because it is the only part that can be regenerated when the recipe is complete.

tables.name: ml_datasets
tables.comment: Snapshot of the data used for training. Stores the literal query and its hash so that a change in the underlying data is detectable: two models sharing a query but differing in n_rows or class_distribution were NOT trained on the same thing.

tables.name: ml_model_features
tables.comment: Which columns entered each model, and in what role. Recording the EXCLUDED ones with their reason is what turns a decision into an auditable decision.

tables.name: ml_model_metrics
tables.comment: Metricas en formato largo. Anadir una metrica nueva no requiere cambiar el esquema.

tables.name: ml_model_artifacts
tables.comment: The serialised binary, in its own table so a light dump can skip it without losing the registry entry (same pattern as the vectors in rag_chunks). It is the REGENERABLE part, provided the recipe in ml_models is complete.

families.title: The literature corpus
families.blurb: The catalogue, the passages with their vectors, and the contextual sentence written for each one.

tables.name: rag_documents
tables.comment: Un registro por fichero fuente indexado en el RAG. No contiene vectores.

tables.name: rag_chunks
tables.comment: Trozos de texto vectorizados. Columnas id/text/metadata/embedding impuestas por LangChain.

tables.name: rag_chunk_context
tables.comment: Sidecar for contextual-retrieval sentences generated externally (Gemini/Antigravity). Never written to by anything that also writes rag_chunks.embedding.

families.title: The knowledge graph
families.blurb: Samples, ligands, metals, modulators and measurements as nodes, and what connects them as edges - in Postgres, not in a separate graph database.

tables.name: kg_nodes
tables.comment: One row per "thing that exists" in the knowledge graph: sample, ligand, metal, modulator, measurement, descriptor/KPI, paper, ML model or ML prediction.

tables.name: kg_edges
tables.comment: One row per relation between two nodes: SAMPLE-USES_LIGAND->LIGAND, SAMPLE-HAS_MEASUREMENT->MEASUREMENT, and in future PAPER-SUPPORTS->DESCRIPTOR.

families.title: Governance
families.blurb: Who did what, who is allowed to ask, and what every column means. The part that turns a database into a record.

tables.name: data_dictionary
tables.comment: The schema documentation as queryable rows: one per column of every table and view. It exists so the web application and the AI agents read the dictionary FROM the database instead of carrying it hard-coded. Coverage must be 100 %: an incomplete dictionary cannot distinguish an undocumented column from a column that does not exist.

tables.name: audit_log
tables.comment: Audit log table tracking all system actions, approvals, rejections, and execution metrics

tables.name: authorized_researchers
tables.comment: Whitelist table storing authorized researchers and dynamic self-enrolled demo users

tables.name: agent_chat_log
tables.comment: Transcript of every exchange with the RAG agent: who asked, what they asked, what was answered. Complements audit_log, which logs tool calls rather than dialogue.

tables.name: agent_owner_secret
tables.comment: Holds the md5 hash of the single owner access token for the ALCheMy-RAG chat agent. Never the plaintext token. Verified by agent_verify_owner(); downstream agent_* functions only receive the resulting boolean (p_is_owner), never the token.

tables.name: ai_agent_calls
tables.comment: One row per AI agent invocation (Gemini or local Ollama fallback), for cost/usage auditing - never trims to only successful calls.

views.name: v_agent_samples
views.comment: One row per synthesised sample with its metal, linker, date and how many characterisation techniques it has.

views.name: v_agente_muestras
views.comment: Read-only view for the RAG agent. n_tecnicas is the weak label of experimental interest. Duplicate of v_agent_samples, kept only until callers are migrated.

views.name: v_ml_deployed
views.comment: The models being served right now, and in which role. One row per deployment slot; if it is empty, nothing is deployed.

views.name: v_ml_features
views.comment: Feature table for machine learning (v3, 2026-09-02). Against v2: corrected volume units — the dilute stock solutions in the spreadsheet (HCl 0.6M, HCl 3M, HF 3M) are recorded in mL and not uL, and their water now enters the balance — plus three recovered solvent columns (glacial AcOH, H2PO4, NH4OH). Glacial acetic acid counts both as a solvent and as a carboxylic modulator.

views.name: v_ml_model_input_contract
views.comment: The input columns of every model, in the exact order they must be supplied. This is what any service loading a model from the registry must read; do not hard-code the list.

views.name: v_ml_model_registry
views.comment: The model registry in readable form, without the binaries: which models exist, on what data, with what result, and whether they are still reproducible.

views.name: v_pxrd_labels_full
views.comment: Crystallinity labels joined to the synthesis conditions they belong to. needs_relink flags labels orphaned by a re-ingestion.

views.name: v_rag_biblioteca
views.comment: Corpus catalogue with the citation already assembled. Read-only tool for the agent so it never invents a reference. Duplicate of v_rag_library, kept only until callers are migrated.

views.name: v_rag_library
views.comment: Corpus catalogue with the citation already assembled. Read-only tool for the agent so it never invents a reference.
